company.name: Wallat
company.shortDescription: Wallat lets professionals create, share, and track branded contact profiles directly inside Apple, Google, and Samsung Wallet.
company.description:
Wallat is a networking intelligence platform that transforms how professionals share contact information and measure engagement. The company creates native wallet passes for Apple Wallet, Google Wallet, and Samsung Wallet — the only platform to support all three — paired with an auto-generated profile website and visitor engagement analytics.

The Product
Users sign up at app.wallat.id and create a branded digital business card in 90 seconds using a WYSIWYG editor that shows exact final output across all three wallet platforms. On first publish, Wallat auto-generates a cinematic, designer-quality profile website with animated scrolls, CSS-driven interactions, and multiple switchable templates — eliminating the need for separate web development or design.

Every profile comes with business card intelligence: heatmaps showing where visitors tap, session replay visualizing the complete user journey, engagement scoring ranking every contact 0–100, and visitor timelines documenting all interactions. Recipients need no app install — they scan a QR code and land on the profile in their browser.

Key Differentiators:
1. Samsung Wallet Coverage — Wallat is the only platform supporting native Samsung Wallet cards, covering hundreds of millions of devices competitors ignore.

2. Physical Card Tracking — Print QR codes on paper business cards and track every scan with the same intelligence as digital shares. Dynamic QR codes let users change destinations without reprinting.

3. AI-Powered Profiles — The AI Profile Optimizer auto-fills profile websites with contextual, role-specific content based on user profession, company, and designation. Templates pre-populate with user data, not demo content.

4. Team & Enterprise Capabilities — Teams plan includes HQ dashboard, shared lead inbox, per-rep leaderboards, hard brand lock, and org-wide push campaigns. Enterprise adds SSO, white-label, and unlimited seats.

Monetization:
Freemium model with five tiers: Starter (free forever), Pro ($12/month), Pro Intel ($19/month), Business ($13/user/month), Enterprise (custom). The company has already closed enterprise pilots with organizations like Special Olympics UAE.

Market Position:
Wallat competes in the digital business card category but owns a unique positioning as the engagement intelligence layer. While competitors like HiHello, Popl, Blinq, and Linq focus on replacing paper cards, Wallat measures what happens after the handshake — turning every business card into a measurable sales signal.

Team & Funding:
Founded by Nasrudheen Kakkavath, a software engineer with 20+ years building enterprise systems, including patent contributions to Zynga Membase and zPerfmon and led custom Software development and complex AI projects for government and enterprise clients. The company raised $50,000 in pre-seed funding in April 2026.
